site_name: Basement Flat (front), 73 Cadogan Square, LONDON, SW1X 0DY
description: Replacement of existing single glass in front door with double-glazed security units; replacement and adjustment of rear door to similar design, making fanlight shorter to allow for timber panel above, that will accommodate existing gas pipe; lowering of courtyard floor in accordance with damp report, creating falls toward the new drains, and installation of a new tiled floor finish; installation of a new gate by modifying existing historic iron railings, and installation of a traditional metal staircase to provide access from communal garden to boiler room; modification of existing wall in courtyard to create space for the staircase, and installation of a new gate to facilitate a secure, private courtyard for the flat; installation of a new sink in private couryard; creation of a new air vent on southern elevation above window to match existing vent; and installation of external wall mounted lights.
